fact: In an agreement signed in Algiers for 2025-2030 under the Ministry of Agriculture's secretary general, the Algerian Space Agency committed to supply satellite data for desert locust surveillance, and the secretary general said satellite imagery let Algeria control the locust invasion and serves as an early-warning system.
title: Lutte antiacridienne: L'ASAL met son imagerie satellitaire au service de la CLCPRO
